The '''Salespeak 7 droid''' was a class of [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droid]] that became available around the time of the publication of [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab's]] ''[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide]]''. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] made use of new [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] technology to instantaneously translate the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Language/Legends|language]] [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyrriwook]].<ref name="Travel Guide" />
